rationale: The designation adds ten Mexican entities spanning unrelated sectors (horse racing/restaurant, road and building construction, real estate development, propane and gas wholesale, equine breeding, and transport/logistics) nearly all tagged 'Linked To: GARZA GARCIA, Gamaliel', a Cartel del Noreste facilitator. Several were incorporated only months before designation (e.g. 11 Mar 2025 for three gas wholesalers, p.2), consistent with SAN004's doctrine of an entity with little genuine economic substance set up to give a sanctioned interest a clean commercial face while the real party (the cartel/Garza Garcia) stays hidden behind it. The press release itself frames this as Cartel del Noreste's 'Expansive Criminal Network' (p.1) of front businesses.
